t: A twelve-core Arm desktop motherboard with a 30 TOPS AI helper.
steps: Buy the board from Arace Tech, the official Radxa partner. Check stock first, as all versions showed sold out.
Get an NVMe SSD and a 20 volt USB-C PD charger of 65 watts or more.
Download a Radxa Debian image or a standard arm64 Linux installer.
Write the installer to a USB stick with an image writing app.
Connect power, an HDMI screen, a keyboard and a network cable.
Follow the quick start guide on the Radxa docs site.
Update the UEFI firmware from the Radxa download page.
